briefdescription.para: Measures OCM traffic metrics using the AXI Performance Monitor driver.

detaileddescription.para:
This file contains a design example that shows how to use the AXI Performance Monitor driver APIs. The example measures the following metrics captured at OCM of Zynq MP:
Write Transaction Count
Write Byte Count
Read Transaction Count
Read Byte Count
